descriptions.modern: Single column, accent-coloured headings, optional photo. The most balanced choice for most private-sector applications.
descriptions.ats: Single column, black and white, no icons. The layout applicant tracking systems read most reliably. No photo.
descriptions.elegant: Serif type, centred header, double rule. Makes a serious impression in public sector, academia, law and corporate roles.
descriptions.technical: Coloured top band, skills as tags in two columns. Compact and easy to scan for software and technical roles.
descriptions.sidebar: Two columns; photo, contact and skills in a coloured sidebar. Reading order for ATS starts with the main column.
descriptions.corporate: Serif headings, name on the left, contact details stacked on the right and a heavy rule. A dignified single column for senior and executive roles.
descriptions.two-column: Full-width header; skills, languages and certificates in a light grey right-hand column. Keeps a lot of information tidy on one page.
descriptions.contrast: Dark header band with a coloured stripe and an all-caps name. For sales, marketing and leadership roles that call for a strong first impression.
descriptions.swiss: Section titles in a narrow left column and a large, plain name. A minimal, grid-based design with plenty of white space.
descriptions.academic: EB Garamond type, centred header and dates in their own left column. For academic applications, fellowships and research positions.
descriptions.timeline: Experience and education on a vertical timeline with their dates. Shows your career progression at a glance.
descriptions.creative: Coloured edge stripe, a large all-caps name and outlined skill tags. For design, media and creative roles.
descriptions.startup: Thin colour strip on top, a large name, dates under each title and skill tags. A contemporary look for startups and product teams.
descriptions.airy: Light-tinted header band, soft type and generous spacing. Leaves a clean, trustworthy impression in healthcare, education and services.
descriptions.graduate: Coloured box headings, skill tags and a warm typeface. Puts education and projects first for people early in their careers.
descriptions.light-sidebar: Photo, contact and skills in a light-tinted sidebar. A softer, easier-to-read option for those who like sidebars.
descriptions.editorial: A large, light name like a magazine page, serif type and a narrow side column set off by a fine rule. For communications, publishing and content roles.
descriptions.boutique: Centred, widely spaced all-caps name and headings flanked by rules. Elegant yet restrained; suits hospitality, fashion and services.
descriptions.compact: Small type, narrow margins and tight spacing. An ATS-friendly single column for fitting a long history onto one page.
descriptions.formal: Black and white, serif type and a centred all-caps name. A measured layout for formal applications in law, government and finance.
descriptions.classic: Black and white serif type; name on the left, contact on the right, double rule. A traditional look that is fully ATS-compatible.
descriptions.minimal: Black and white, centred header and undecorated headings. The plainest ATS option, with nothing to distract the reader.
